proof_body:
by
  intro A _
  have hk : RingHom.ker (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) = Ideal.span {Polynomial.X} := by
    simpa using Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom (0 : A)
  have hs : Function.Surjective (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A)) := fun a => ⟨Polynomial.C a, by simp⟩
  let e := RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hs
  constructor
  · rw [← hk, ← Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime]
    exact ⟨fun h => MulEquiv.isDomain _ e.symm.toMulEquiv, fun h => MulEquiv.isDomain _ e.toMulEquiv⟩
  · rw [← hk, Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient]
    exact ⟨fun h => MulEquiv.isField h e.symm.toMulEquiv, fun h => MulEquiv.isField h e.toMulEquiv⟩
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A], ((Ideal.span {Polynomial.X} : Ideal (Polynomial A)).IsPrime ↔ IsDomain A) ∧ ((Ideal.span {Polynomial.X} : Ideal (Polynomial A)).IsMaximal ↔ IsField A)
